title: Industrial Chemical Process Tower & Column Project
summary: A large-scale industrial chemical tower project involving vertical process columns, structural platforms, and associated equipment. Tongyang participated extensively in equipment-related engineering coordination, fabrication support, and project implementation, contributing to the execution of complex chemical processing facilities.
body:
Project Overview

This industrial chemical process tower project involves large-scale vertical columns designed for chemical and petrochemical processing applications, including separation, absorption, distillation, and purification.

The project features multiple industrial towers with integrated access platforms, ladders, structural supports, and associated process connections.

Project Highlights

  • Industry: Chemical & Petrochemical

  • Equipment: Industrial Process Towers & Columns

  • Construction: Large Vertical Welded Structures

  • Materials: Carbon Steel / Stainless Steel, subject to specifications

  • Applications: Separation, Absorption & Distillation

  • Engineering: Customized Equipment Configuration

Project Description and Tongyang's Role

Tongyang was actively involved in the project, supporting equipment-related engineering coordination, manufacturing activities, and technical implementation.

Working closely with project engineering and construction teams, Tongyang contributed to the coordination of large-scale tower equipment requirements, fabrication considerations, and installation-related technical matters.

The project reflects Tongyang's capabilities in handling complex industrial equipment, particularly large vertical process vessels and associated structures used in chemical and petrochemical facilities.

Through technical collaboration and manufacturing support, Tongyang contributed to the project's equipment-related execution requirements.
